Introduction

SIKKOO is a three-member hip-hop group that debuted under AOMG. The lineup includes rapper-vocalists Koo Min-jae, 200 (also known as Eback), and Yosi (44ninja). The group first drew widespread attention in 2024 when their performance video for “Team Tomodachi (KR Remix)” surpassed 10 million views on YouTube.

The name SIKKOO is derived from a Korean word meaning "those who eat together," symbolizing a familial bond. The group aims to pioneer a distinctive style of "domestic hip-hop" by fusing traditional Korean elements with modern sounds.

They officially debuted on April 29, 2025, with the EP ‘GAN’.
